+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_VALID_BY = ("name_length", "email_length")
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_top_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    by = params.get("by")
+    if by not in _VALID_BY:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    raw = params.get("n")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    n = int(raw)
+    if not 1 <= n <= 10:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    field = "name" if by == "name_length" else "email"
+    ranked = sorted(users.list_users(), key=lambda user: (-len(user[field]), user["id"]))
+    return 200, {"users": ranked[:n]}
